value.desc: Subleaf enumerates supported PCONFIG target IDs
value.text:
A "PCONFIG target" is defined as any hardware block on the platform which can be configured using the PCONFIG opcode. The PCONFIG opcode supports multiple leaf functions, selected through input EAX register, where each PCONFIG leaf function applies to a PCONFIG target.
So far, only one PCONFIG target is defined: MKTME, the Multikey Total Memory Encryption engine, denoted by target ID 1. Target ID 0 is invalid.
Thus, PCONFIG leaf function EAX=0x0, MKTME_KEY_PROGRAM, is supported and will not result in a #GP(0) iff one of this CPUID 0x1b leaf "Target Identier" subleaves marks PCONFIG target ID 1 (MKTME engine) as supported.
Reference: Intel Architecture Memory Encryption Technologies Specification, Revision 1.4 (Auguest 2022), Section 6.2.1 "PCONFIG Description".
